entities.summary: Faith47, alternatively Faith XLVII, is a South African interdisciplinary artist. Her inaugural museum exhibition CLAIR OBSUR took place at the Museum of Fine Arts of Nancy (2023). She has held solo exhibitions in San Francisco (2025), Paris (2023), Cape Town (2021), Miami (2018), New York City (2015), London (2014) and Johannesburg (2012).
